subject.title: fix(whatsapp): preserve live connections across reloads

question: Should the runtime-context reload fix land through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110762 with this PR rebased to QA-only changes, or should this PR become the single combined landing vehicle?
rationale: The two open member-authored PRs share the exact production runtime commit but each describes a different intended scope, and the protected maintainer label requires a human choice of review and rollback boundary.

options.title: Split by stated ownership
options.body: Land the production reload repair through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110762 and rebase this PR to retain only the account-aware QA changes.

options.title: Use one combined PR
options.body: Keep the production and QA changes together here, then close or withdraw the overlapping runtime-only PR before merge.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Hold both PRs until maintainers confirm that a process-lifetime WhatsApp channel-runtime owner is the desired reload lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Split by stated ownership
recommendation.body: Land the production reload repair through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110762 and rebase this PR to retain only the account-aware QA changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The history and both open branches show direct ownership of the runtime-context refactor and its proposed repair split.
